id.description: Globally unique identifier for this change.

ifsId.description: IFS system identifier for this Change.

entityType.description: Entity type discriminator. Always "Change" for Change entities.

basedOn.description: Id of the object this object is derived from.

entityDocumentationUrl.description: URL for documentation about this entity.

title.description: Human-readable title summarizing the proposed change.

description.description: Detailed explanation of what this change proposes and why it is needed.

summary.description: Short explanation of what this change proposes and why it is needed.

reason.description: explanation of why this change is being proposed.

changes.description: ChangeItem entities describing each proposed object-level operation in this change.

comments.description: Recent Comment entities for this change, such as the first page of comments.

commentsUrl.description: URL where the full comment thread for this change can be fetched or viewed.

reviewComments.description: ReviewComment entities tied to changed objects, fields, records, or diff entries.

authors.description: Member entities that authored or co-authored this change.

mainAuthorId.description: Identifier of the primary member responsible for this change.

mainAuthor.description: Primary member responsible for this change.

reviewers.description: Member entities requested or assigned to review this change.

diffUrl.description: URL showing a diff for all changed objects, similar to a GitHub pull request diff.

number.description: Human-friendly sequence number for this change inside the relevant system or scope.

merged.description: Whether this change has been merged into the target system state.

hasConflict.description: Whether this change currently conflicts with another change or with the target system state.

links.description: Any links related to this change.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this change was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this change was last updated.

mergedAt.description: Optional timestamp when this change was merged.

closedAt.description: Optional timestamp when this change was closed without being merged.
